newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell 7.5 pct of UES this year. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell 7.5 pct of UES this year. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: Russia plans to privatise 7.5 percent of national power company Unified Energy System (UES) before the end of the year and has named CS First Boston as the coordinator of the deal, the state property committee said on Friday.
CS First Boston would also be the bookrunner for the deal, the committee said in a statement.
ABN AMRO Rothschild, Brunswick, Flemings and Russian banks MFK and Menatep were named joint lead managers.

The volume of issued securities would be divided into four regional tranches. ABN AMRO Rothschild would be lead and bookrunner for the European tranche, CS First Boston would lead the North American tranche, Flemings would lead the Asian tranche and MFK and Menatep would lead the Russian tranche.
Brunswick will advise the property committee on analysing UES and preparing analytical material for investors.

The property committee said the selection commission's decision to choose CS First Boston had taken into account the large sums which their plans would bring to the federal budget and the cost of financial consultation services.
It said Salomon Brothers,ING Barings and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell had also competed for the right to be consultant.
Under a current government resolution, the state is to keep a 51 percent stake in UES until the end of 1998. A further 8.5 percent stake is also state-owned.

Foreigners own some 20 percent of the company. UES president Anatoly Dyakov said last month foreigners had not put any money into the company and that an increase in the number of shares in foreeign hands was inadmissible.
The company also plans to issue American Depositary Receipts.
RAO Yedinaya Energeticheskaya Sistema Rossii is among Russia's most liquid shares. It stood at $0.0763 (corrects from $0.763) on the Russian Trading System at 1245 GMT.
Russia is committed to raising 12 trillion roubles from privatisation this year.
